title: UserBench: An Interactive Gym Environment for User-Centric Agents
venue: NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Scaling Environments for Agents
authors_zh: Cheng Qian, Zuxin Liu, Akshara Prabhakar, Zhiwei Liu, Jianguo Zhang, Haolin Chen, Heng Ji, Weiran Yao, Shelby Heinecke, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, Huan Wang
paper_type_zh: 用户偏好澄清型智能体评测环境与任务发布
best_for_zh: 研究环境智能体数据、用户模拟器、混合 verifier、偏好澄清评测与发布审计的读者
one_line: UserBench releases 3,122 unique travel-planning tasks and a mixed GPT-4o/rule Gym environment for preference elicitation, but not the paper's rollout trajectories, and its counts, judge labels, randomness, and best-option ties require a pinned audit.
UserBench 发布 3,122 个唯一旅行规划任务及 GPT-4o/规则混合验证的 Gym 交互环境，用于评测偏好澄清、搜索与推荐；论文运行轨迹未发布，计数、judge 编号、随机性与 best_id 并列标签仍需固定版本审计。
why: It shows how an interactive agent benchmark can turn clarifying questions, searches, implicit user responses, and option choices into state/action rewards, while also demonstrating why prospective train splits are not training evidence and why judge, label, split, and replay metadata determine reuse safety.
inclusion_reason: UserBench makes user-centric agent feedback inspectable as an environment contract: underspecified prompts lead to clarification/search/answer transitions, GPT-4o and rules attach step and outcome rewards, and public task labels expose concrete replay and reward-quality risks.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The primary paper record is arXiv:2507.22034v1, submitted on 2025-07-29. The official NeurIPS schedule lists UserBench as a poster in the NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Scaling Environments for Agents; this Card does not broaden that evidence into a main-conference or proceedings claim. Release-level statements are frozen to the official repository at commit 80506d2ab484cab843e60a2401ff3e0290d05b87, inspected on 2026-07-20. The repository has neither a tag nor a GitHub Release, and its benchmark data were added after arXiv v1.

UserBench studies a concrete interaction problem: a travel-planning agent receives an underspecified request, must discover implicit preferences through clarification, issue searches against a mock database, and recommend option IDs across flight, hotel, apartment, rental-car, and restaurant aspects. Static answer scoring cannot expose whether the agent asked a useful question, searched with complete constraints, tracked which aspect had been handled, or guessed before enough information was available. UserBench therefore makes the environment and its feedback part of the evaluation surface.

The reusable release is a task/environment specification rather than a corpus of completed trajectories. An underlying JSON task binds a scenario ID and initial request to difficulty, travel dimensions, explicit and implicit preference expressions, structured search arguments, correct/wrong/noise option records, correct IDs, and one designated best_id with rationale. Parquet rows wrap the task with system/user prompt messages, split, environment name, ground-truth IDs, and environment-construction arguments. At runtime, an episode adds agent thought, search/action/answer calls, simulated-user or database observations, conversation/action history, preference state, scalar rewards, and termination or truncation. No complete archive of the paper's successful and failed episodes was verified.

This object belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because observations, tool actions, environment responses, state changes, rewards, and terminal conditions define the measurable reasoning process. Its role is evaluation only in this paper: the named train split and discussion of possible SFT/RL support are prospective, not evidence of model training. Current evidence supports L4-depth description of the object, construction, mixed feedback contract, evaluation, release, and audit risks, while the accepted curation_level remains L3_summary_ready. Construction prompts, judge calibration, semantic split leakage, data-specific rights, and replay manifests remain unknown.

主要论文记录是 2025 年 7 月 29 日提交的 arXiv:2507.22034v1。NeurIPS 官方日程将 UserBench 列为 NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Scaling Environments for Agents 的 poster；本卡片不会把该证据扩大为主会或 proceedings 发表。发布层面的结论固定到 2026 年 7 月 20 日核验的官方仓库 commit 80506d2ab484cab843e60a2401ff3e0290d05b87。仓库没有 tag 或 GitHub Release，benchmark 数据是在 arXiv v1 之后加入的。

UserBench 研究一个具体交互问题：旅行规划 agent 接收信息不足的请求，需要通过澄清发现隐含偏好，向 mock database 发起搜索，并在 flight、hotel、apartment、rental-car 与 restaurant 五类方面推荐 option ID。静态答案评分无法暴露 agent 是否问了有效问题、是否带齐约束搜索、是否跟踪已处理方面，或是否在信息不足时过早猜测。因此 UserBench 把环境及其反馈纳入 evaluation surface。

可复用 release 是 task/environment specification，而不是完成轨迹语料。底层 JSON task 把 scenario ID 与初始请求绑定到 difficulty、travel dimension、显式与隐式偏好表达、结构化 search argument、correct/wrong/noise option record、correct ID，以及一个带理由的指定 best_id。Parquet 行再封装 system/user prompt message、split、environment name、ground-truth ID 与环境创建参数。运行时 episode 才会加入 agent thought、search/action/answer call、模拟用户或 database observation、conversation/action history、preference state、scalar reward 与 termination/truncation。没有核验到论文成功和失败运行的完整 episode archive。

该对象属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为 observation、tool action、environment response、state change、reward 与 terminal condition 共同定义可测量的推理过程。论文中的实际用途仅为 evaluation：命名为 train 的 split 和对未来 SFT/RL 支持的讨论只是预期用途，不能作为训练证据。现有证据足以按 L4 深度描述数据对象、构造流程、混合反馈契约、评测、发布与审计风险，但已接受的 curation_level 仍保持 L3_summary_ready。构造 prompt、judge 校准、跨 split 语义泄漏、数据专用权利声明与 replay manifest 仍为 unknown。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The one-sentence contribution is: UserBench couples a structured implicit-preference task bank with a Gymnasium travel environment so clarification, search, and recommendation behavior can be evaluated through mixed GPT-4o judgments and rule/state checks rather than only a final free-form answer.

Three layers form the mechanism. First, task construction combines curated preference concepts and indirect expressions across travel aspects, then uses GPT-4o under human supervision to generate an ideal arrangement and correct, wrong, and noise options. Second, a runtime interface requires one interact_with_env call per turn with an agent-emitted thought, a choice in action, search, or answer, and textual content. Third, the environment maintains elicited preferences, search state, remaining option labels, accumulated reward, and episode status while returning simulated-user replies or pre-generated search options.

The feedback contract is mixed. GPT-4o judges whether a free-form search includes the required ground-truth arguments and whether a clarification utterance targets an available preference; it also generates the implicit user reply. Code parses option IDs, checks correct and best sets, updates state, applies rewards, and decides termination/truncation. Default rewards are 0.2 for a newly valid search, 0.2 for a newly elicited preference, 1.0 for the designated best option, 0.8 for another correct option, and 0.0 for a wrong option. The Parquet field reward_model.style: rule therefore does not describe the whole evaluator.

This interface can observe prompt-judge classifications, exact option-ID membership, environment counters, tool history, and final state. It cannot establish that GPT-4o's semantic classifications are unbiased, that a lone best_id is uniquely preferable, that the agent's thought is faithful reasoning, or that synthetic travel interaction transfers to real users and live providers. Termination is not a success predicate: under one-choice mode, a wrong submission can consume an aspect and help end the episode.

The closest comparison class is a standard agent benchmark that scores task completion without making user preference discovery a first-class state variable. UserBench's concrete change is to expose implicit preferences through both active clarification and passive elicitation, then score search and answer behavior within the same environment. The work does not release the resulting model trajectories, so its directional value for reasoning data is the inspectable environment-feedback contract and task release, not a demonstrated training corpus.

一句话贡献是：UserBench 把结构化隐含偏好任务库与 Gymnasium 旅行环境结合起来，通过 GPT-4o 判断和规则/状态检查组成的混合反馈，评测澄清、搜索与推荐行为，而不只检查最终自由文本答案。

机制连接三层对象。第一，task construction 跨多个旅行方面组合人工整理的 preference concept 与间接表达，再由 GPT-4o 在人工监督下生成理想安排以及 correct、wrong 和 noise option。第二，runtime interface 要求每个 turn 调用一次 interact_with_env，字段包含 agent 输出的 thought、action/search/answer 三选一的 choice 与文本 content。第三，环境维护已获取偏好、search state、剩余 option label、累计 reward 与 episode status，并返回模拟用户回复或预生成 search option。

反馈契约是 mixed。GPT-4o 判断自由文本搜索是否包含所需 ground-truth argument、澄清语句是否指向一个可用偏好，并生成隐式用户回复；代码负责解析 option ID、检查 correct/best 集合、更新状态、发放 reward，以及决定 termination/truncation。默认 reward 是：新有效搜索 0.2、新获取偏好 0.2、指定 best option 1.0、其他 correct option 0.8、wrong option 0.0。因此 Parquet 中的 reward_model.style: rule 不能概括整个 evaluator。

该接口可以观察 prompt judge 的分类、option ID 的精确集合归属、environment counter、tool history 与 final state；它不能证明 GPT-4o 的语义分类无偏，不能证明单一 best_id 确实唯一更优，不能证明 agent 输出的 thought 是忠实推理，也不能证明合成旅行交互可迁移到真实用户与在线服务。termination 也不是成功判据：one-choice 模式下，wrong submission 仍可能消耗一个 aspect 并推动 episode 结束。

最接近的比较类别是只评估任务完成、但不把用户偏好发现设为一等状态变量的常规 agent benchmark。UserBench 的具体变化是同时通过主动澄清与被动触发暴露隐含偏好，并在同一环境中评分 search 与 answer 行为。该工作没有发布由此产生的模型轨迹，因此它对 reasoning data 的方向价值在于可检查的 environment-feedback contract 与任务 release，而不是已经证明可用的训练语料。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and construction. Authors curate travel preferences and multiple indirect elicitation expressions for flight, hotel, apartment, rental-car, and restaurant. Table 2 reports 82 final preferences and 902 elicitation ways. Preferences are randomly combined into difficulty-tiered compositions such as Travel-22, 2222, 33, 233, 333, 44, 334, and 444. GPT-4o generates the ideal travel-arrangement statement. For every included aspect, GPT-4o also generates correct options satisfying all preferences, wrong options violating at least one, and noise options that are irrelevant or unrealistic, under human supervision. The exact construction prompts, GPT-4o endpoint, temperature, retry policy, random seed, rejection counts, curator assignment, and adjudication process are undisclosed.

Task packaging and split. Eight JSON files store scenario-level preference structure, implicit utterances, search arguments, typed options and reasons, correct/wrong/noise IDs, one best_id, and best_id_thought. The official release wraps these tasks in 32 train/test Parquet files for single- and multi-choice modes. Exhaustive ID inspection finds 3,122 unique tasks: 2,651 train and 471 test, with no ID overlap. Each choice variant repeats the same task IDs, producing 6,244 serialized rows but not 6,244 unique scenarios. Split logic, seed, semantic-near-duplicate checks, and decontamination are unknown.

Reset and action loop. A reset returns the task description, goal, feedback, step count, episode state, preference counts/ratio, and last reward. Every step requires interact_with_env(thought, choice, content). A search requests options for an aspect; an action asks or converses with the user; an answer submits an option ID. The environment records action and conversation histories, tracks active/passive elicitation, and returns either a simulated-user utterance, search feedback plus shuffled pre-generated options, or answer feedback. The agent's thought is stored as an emitted field but is not independently verified.

Judge, reward, and environment. GPT-4o evaluates whether search text matches every ground-truth argument and identifies the requested aspect. A newly valid search yields 0.2 and exposes its option database. GPT-4o also classifies clarification utterances; a valid question about an available preference reveals the preference indirectly and yields 0.2. After three non-preference turns, the default environment passively reveals one remaining preference chosen with Python random.choice. Rule code parses answer IDs and gives 1.0 to best_id, 0.8 to another correct ID, and the default 0.0 to a wrong ID. An episode terminates when no best options remain or one answer has been recorded for every aspect in one-choice mode; it truncates at the step limit.

Evaluation and release boundary. Main experiments use GPT-4o as user simulator/judge, temperature 0, a maximum of 20 turns, 2,048 output tokens per turn, and one run per model-task; the paper reports eight H200 GPUs for evaluation hosting. Every fifth search is configured to simulate failure. The public repository releases task/environment data, evaluator code, prompts, schema, and Parquet launch records, but no complete corpus of paper-run episodes, raw judge outputs, retries, or environment logs. Reproduction should pin commit 80506d2, all data files, dependencies, environment configuration, exact model endpoint, prompts, API behavior, and both Python and NumPy randomness. The paper performs evaluation only and reports no SFT, RL, or agent-training experiment.

输入与构造。 作者为 flight、hotel、apartment、rental-car 与 restaurant 整理旅行偏好及多种间接 elicitation expression；Table 2 报告最终 82 个 preference 与 902 种 elicitation way。偏好被随机组合为 Travel-22、2222、33、233、333、44、334、444 等难度分层 composition，GPT-4o 生成理想 travel-arrangement statement。对每个纳入的 aspect，GPT-4o 还在人工监督下生成满足全部偏好的 correct option、至少违反一项偏好的 wrong option，以及无关或不现实的 noise option。确切构造 prompt、GPT-4o endpoint、temperature、retry policy、random seed、拒绝数量、curator 分工与 adjudication process 均未披露。

任务封装与 split。 八个 JSON 文件保存 scenario 级 preference structure、隐式 utterance、search argument、带类型的 option 与理由、correct/wrong/noise ID、一个 best_id 及 best_id_thought。官方 release 再把这些任务包装为 single-choice 与 multi-choice 模式下的 32 个 train/test Parquet 文件。对全部 ID 的核验得到 3,122 个唯一任务：2,651 train、471 test，ID 零重叠。两个 choice variant 重复相同 task ID，因此共有 6,244 行序列化记录，但不是 6,244 个唯一 scenario。split 规则、seed、语义近重复检查与去污染均为 unknown。

Reset 与 action loop。 reset 返回 task description、goal、feedback、step count、episode state、preference count/ratio 与 last reward。每一步必须调用 interact_with_env(thought, choice, content)。search 请求某个 aspect 的 option，action 向用户提问或对话，answer 提交 option ID。环境记录 action 与 conversation history，跟踪 active/passive elicitation，并返回模拟用户 utterance、search feedback 与打乱顺序的预生成 option，或 answer feedback。agent 的 thought 只是被保存的输出字段，没有独立真实性验证。

Judge、reward 与环境。 GPT-4o 判断 search text 是否匹配全部 ground-truth argument，并识别所请求 aspect；首次有效搜索奖励 0.2，并暴露对应 option database。GPT-4o 还分类澄清 utterance；针对可用偏好的有效问题会以间接表达揭示该偏好，并奖励 0.2。连续三个非偏好 turn 后，默认环境通过 Python random.choice 被动揭示一个剩余偏好。规则代码解析 answer ID：best_id 得 1.0，其他 correct ID 得 0.8，wrong ID 默认得 0.0。没有剩余 best option，或 one-choice 模式下每个 aspect 都已记录一个 answer 时，episode 终止；达到 step limit 时截断。

评测与发布边界。 主实验采用 GPT-4o 作为 user simulator/judge，temperature 0、最多 20 个 turn、每 turn 最多 2,048 output token，且每个 model-task 运行一次；论文报告使用八张 H200 承载评测。配置中每第五次 search 会模拟失败。公开仓库发布 task/environment data、evaluator code、prompt、schema 与 Parquet 启动记录，但没有论文运行 episode、raw judge output、retry 或 environment log 的完整语料。复现应固定 commit 80506d2、全部 data file、dependency、environment configuration、确切 model endpoint、prompt、API behavior，以及 Python 和 NumPy 随机性。论文实际只做 evaluation，没有报告 SFT、RL 或 agent-training 实验。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Scale evidence must distinguish scenarios from serialized variants. Paper Table 2 reports 2,651 train and 471 test scenarios, with test counts of 118 easy, 201 medium, and 152 hard and train counts of 666, 1,130, and 855. Exhaustive inspection of the released Parquet files agrees: each single- or multi-choice variant has the same 3,122 unique task IDs, split 2,651/471 with no ID overlap. The two variants together contain 6,244 rows, but counting them as unique tasks would double the benchmark. Section 3.5 instead says 417 test points; the current release and Table 2 support 471, so 417 is retained as an unresolved paper inconsistency rather than silently corrected.

The paper also uses three different scale descriptions. Its introduction claims 4K+ proposed scenarios; Figure 1 and Section 3.5 say random combination can enable 10K+ possible scenarios; the verified public release contains 3,122 unique IDs. The 10K+ figure describes construction capacity, not released size, and the 4K+ headline is not reconciled with the release. These counts provide evidence about recipe and packaging, not about semantic correctness or data quality.

Under the paper's single-choice setup, GPT-4o obtains score 0.329, valid-search rate 82.48%, valid-action rate 27.82%, and active preference elicitation 24.06% in Table 3. The authors report that no tested model actively elicits 31% of preferences. Section 5 further reports that adding turns does not consistently improve performance and that pass-k raises the maximum score but not the average; qualitative failures include early guessing, repeated or off-topic dialogue, and lost aspect state. These are author-reported, single-run results under a GPT-4o simulator/judge, maximum 20 turns, temperature 0, and the stated models. They were not independently reproduced and cannot certify task labels, judge validity, or training value.

Repository evidence establishes a mixed evaluator. Search and clarification decisions call GPT-4o prompts, while option-ID rewards and termination are implemented in code. The paper's Figure 8 numbers judge types as 1=available preference, 2=unavailable, 3=vague, 4=normal; the public prompt/code instead uses 1=normal, 2=available, 3=unavailable, 4=vague, and commit inspection shows this mapping from the first public repository commit. This is material documentation drift because an implementation copied from the figure can route classifications incorrectly.

Release inspection also produces direct negative evidence. Default passive elicitation uses unseeded random.choice; an official task record states that two restaurant options have the same cost level and either could be chosen, yet only R8 is labeled best_id, so the other correct choice receives 0.8 rather than 1.0. No full run archive, raw judge responses, dropped-run ledger, independent verifier calibration, external overlap audit, or exhaustive 3,122-task semantic label audit was found. Benchmark scores therefore measure agents under this evaluator; they are not proof that the released tasks or rewards are high-quality training data.

规模证据必须区分 scenario 与序列化 variant。论文 Table 2 报告 2,651 个 train 和 471 个 test scenario，其中 test 为 118 easy、201 medium、152 hard，train 为 666、1,130、855。对发布 Parquet 的完整核验与之吻合：single-choice 与 multi-choice variant 各自包含相同的 3,122 个唯一 task ID，按 2,651/471 划分且 ID 零重叠。两个 variant 合计 6,244 行，但把它们当成唯一 task 会让 benchmark 数量翻倍。Section 3.5 却写成 417 个 test point；当前 release 与 Table 2 支持 471，因此卡片保留 417 为未解决的论文内部冲突，而不是静默改正。

论文还使用三种不同的规模描述。Introduction 声称提出 4K+ scenario；Figure 1 与 Section 3.5 称随机组合可支持 10K+ possible scenario；核验后的公开 release 只有 3,122 个唯一 ID。10K+ 描述构造容量，不是发布规模；4K+ 标题数字也没有与 release 调和。这些数量是 recipe 与 packaging 的证据，不是语义正确性或数据质量证据。

在论文 single-choice 设置下，Table 3 中 GPT-4o 的 score 为 0.329、valid-search rate 为 82.48%、valid-action rate 为 27.82%、active preference elicitation 为 24.06%。作者还报告所有被测模型都不会主动获取 31% 的偏好。Section 5 进一步报告：增加 turn 不能稳定改善表现，pass-k 提高最大值却不提高平均值；定性失败包括过早猜测、重复或偏题对话，以及丢失 aspect state。这些是 GPT-4o simulator/judge、最多 20 turn、temperature 0 与指定模型条件下的作者报告单次运行结果，未被独立复现，不能认证 task label、judge 有效性或训练价值。

仓库证据确认 evaluator 为混合类型。search 与 clarification 决策调用 GPT-4o prompt，option-ID reward 与 termination 则由代码实现。论文 Figure 8 的 judge type 编号是 1=available preference、2=unavailable、3=vague、4=normal；公开 prompt/code 使用 1=normal、2=available、3=unavailable、4=vague，且 commit 检查表明该映射从首个公开仓库 commit 起就存在。这是实质性 documentation drift，因为照抄 figure 实现可能错误路由分类结果。

发布检查也给出直接负面证据。默认 passive elicitation 使用未设 seed 的 random.choice；一条官方 task record 明确写道两个 restaurant option 的 cost level 相同、两者均可选择，却只把 R8 标为 best_id，使另一个 correct choice 只能得到 0.8 而非 1.0。没有找到完整 run archive、raw judge response、dropped-run ledger、独立 verifier 校准、外部 overlap audit 或覆盖 3,122 个任务的完整语义标签审计。因此 benchmark score 只测量该 evaluator 下的 agent，不能证明发布任务或 reward 是高质量训练数据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior baseline is an agent evaluation surface that exposes a task, tools, and a terminal answer or outcome but treats user requirements as already stated or as unconstrained dialogue. UserBench changes the data object by encoding a hidden preference inventory with multiple indirect expressions, allowing the agent to reveal that state through targeted questions, and connecting the revealed state to search arguments, option databases, answer labels, and per-transition rewards. The evaluation target is thus not merely itinerary correctness; it includes whether the agent gathered constraints and searched appropriately.

The construction contribution is a structured-to-interactive mapping. Curated preferences are composed across five travel aspects and difficulty tiers; GPT-4o generates an ideal request and correct/wrong/noise options under human supervision; JSON records preserve preference, search, option, and label structure; Parquet wrappers instantiate single- and multi-choice Gym tasks. This is more specific than scaling a prompt list, but it is not fully reconstructable because prompts, seeds, retries, rejection counts, review assignments, and split logic are undisclosed.

The feedback interface is also concrete. Clarification and search use a GPT-4o semantic judge, while answer scoring, state update, and termination use rules. State/action rewards expose whether a preference was newly elicited or a search newly validated, and terminal answer reward distinguishes one designated best option from other correct options. This mixed contract is useful precisely because its failure surfaces are visible: judge error, label ties, passive randomness, and non-success termination can each change the measured outcome.

UserBench does not newly introduce Gymnasium, function calling, LLM user simulation, synthetic travel data, implicit preferences, or LLM-as-judge individually. It integrates them into one user-centric benchmark and releases the task/environment specification. It also does not provide a trajectory release, a training recipe demonstrated by experiments, an independently calibrated verifier, or a guarantee that the root repository license resolves dataset and provider-output rights. The paper's benchmark performance cannot fill those gaps.

For reasoning-data research, the direction signal is the explicit chain underspecified request -> elicitation/search action -> simulated or database observation -> preference/search state -> mixed reward -> answer and termination. Reuse should begin by pinning the repository, reconciling counts and judge numbering, auditing best_id ties and false judge decisions, seeding all randomness, documenting split/decontamination and rights, and releasing both successful and failed episodes. Until then, the novelty supports evaluation and verifier study, not unrestricted training reuse.

先前基线类别是这样一种 agent evaluation surface：它公开 task、tool 与 terminal answer/outcome，但把用户要求视为已给定信息或无约束对话。UserBench 改变了数据对象：它编码带多种间接表达的隐藏 preference inventory，使 agent 能通过定向提问揭示该状态，再把已揭示状态连接到 search argument、option database、answer label 与逐 transition reward。因此评测目标不只包括 itinerary 是否正确，也包括 agent 是否收集约束并正确搜索。

构造贡献是一种 structured-to-interactive 映射。人工整理的 preference 跨五类旅行 aspect 与 difficulty tier 组合；GPT-4o 在人工监督下生成理想 request 与 correct/wrong/noise option；JSON record 保留 preference、search、option 与 label 结构；Parquet wrapper 实例化 single-choice 和 multi-choice Gym task。它比扩大 prompt list 更具体，但由于 prompt、seed、retry、拒绝数量、review assignment 与 split 规则未披露，仍不能完整重建。

反馈接口同样具体。clarification 与 search 使用 GPT-4o semantic judge，answer scoring、state update 与 termination 使用规则。state/action reward 暴露一个偏好是否首次获得、一次搜索是否首次通过，terminal answer reward 则区分一个指定 best option 与其他 correct option。该混合契约的价值恰恰来自可见 failure surface：judge error、label tie、passive randomness 与非成功 termination 都可能改变测量结果。

UserBench 没有分别发明 Gymnasium、function calling、LLM user simulation、合成旅行数据、隐含偏好或 LLM-as-judge；其贡献是把这些组件整合为一个 user-centric benchmark，并发布 task/environment specification。它也没有发布 trajectory，没有用训练实验证明一套 training recipe，没有独立校准 verifier，也没有保证仓库根许可证已经解决数据与 provider-output 权利。论文 benchmark performance 不能填补这些空白。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，方向信号是显式链条 underspecified request -> elicitation/search action -> simulated 或 database observation -> preference/search state -> mixed reward -> answer 与 termination。复用应先固定仓库版本，调和数量与 judge 编号，审计 best_id 并列和 judge 误判，为全部随机性设 seed，说明 split/去污染与权利，并发布成功和失败 episode。在这些工作完成前，该新意支持 evaluation 与 verifier 研究，不支持不受限训练复用。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The released object is not a trajectory corpus. Parquet rows launch tasks and environments; complete paper-run messages, actions, observations, raw judge outputs, retries, fallbacks, errors, seeds, and successful/failed episodes are unavailable. Retention bias and dropped-run accounting cannot be audited.
  • Count documentation is inconsistent. Section 3.5 says 417 test points, Table 2 and the release have 471, the introduction claims 4K+ scenarios, and the public release has 3,122 unique IDs. The 6,244 Parquet rows duplicate single-/multi-choice variants and must not be treated as unique tasks; 10K+ is construction capacity.
  • The paper Figure 8 and repository disagree on judge-type numbering. The public code mapping has existed since the first commit, so replay or reimplementation must follow a pinned code revision rather than assume the appendix labels are executable documentation.
  • GPT-4o controls search validity, clarification validity, preference identification, simulated-user text, and two 0.2 rewards. No calibration set, false-positive/false-negative rate, repeated-judge variance, alternative-judge sensitivity, prompt-attack study, or adversarial audit is reported. Temperature 0 does not establish deterministic API behavior.
  • Passive elicitation selects a remaining preference with unseeded Python random.choice by default, while option shuffling uses a module-level NumPy seed of 42. The evaluation script does not set the passive seed. One-run results can therefore vary through the environment even when agent and simulator temperature is 0.
  • Exact-best_id reward can force a single winner among semantically tied correct options. The inspected restaurant record acknowledges equal cost levels yet assigns only one best ID. A complete 3,122-task audit of best-option ties, correct/wrong/noise semantics, and rationale consistency is unavailable.
  • One-choice termination is not equivalent to success: any submitted option can consume an aspect, including a wrong option, and the episode may end after all aspects are consumed. Reward and termination must be analyzed separately.
  • Split evidence establishes zero exact ID overlap between 2,651 train and 471 test tasks, but the split rule, seed, grouping policy, semantic-near-duplicate analysis, external benchmark overlap, model-pretraining contamination, and post-publication exposure policy are undisclosed.
  • The root repository is Apache-2.0, but no separate dataset card or rights statement covers all generated scenarios/options, upstream preference sources, human supervision, and model-provider output terms. Annotator recruitment, qualifications, assignment, agreement, adjudication, compensation, and consent are unknown.
  • The environment is a synthetic/mock travel domain with static pre-generated options. It can reward exact argument matching and option-ID behavior rather than robust live search or real-user preference handling. Main results are single runs and are not independently reproduced.
  • The paper evaluates agents only. A 2,651-row train split and discussion of future SFT/RL support do not demonstrate SFT, RLVR, PRM, reward-model, or agent-RL use. Benchmark scores are not evidence of training-data quality.
  • No tag or GitHub Release freezes the artifact. Data were added after arXiv v1, the exact dated GPT-4o endpoint is unknown, and dependencies/API behavior are not immutably specified. Reuse must pin commit 80506d2 or another explicit revision and record hashes and configuration.

• 发布对象不是 trajectory corpus。Parquet 行用于启动 task 与 environment；论文运行的完整 message、action、observation、raw judge output、retry、fallback、error、seed，以及成功/失败 episode 均不可用，无法审计 retention bias 与 dropped-run accounting。
  • 数量文档存在冲突。Section 3.5 写 417 个 test point，Table 2 与 release 为 471；Introduction 声称 4K+ scenario，公开 release 只有 3,122 个唯一 ID。6,244 个 Parquet 行是 single-/multi-choice variant 重复，不能当作唯一任务；10K+ 表示构造容量。
  • 论文 Figure 8 与仓库的 judge-type 编号不同。公开代码映射从首个 commit 起就已存在，因此 replay 或重新实现必须依据固定代码 revision，不能假定 appendix label 就是可执行文档。
  • GPT-4o 控制 search validity、clarification validity、preference identification、模拟用户文本与两个 0.2 reward。论文没有报告 calibration set、false-positive/false-negative rate、重复 judge variance、替代 judge sensitivity、prompt attack 或对抗审计。temperature 0 不能证明 API 行为确定。
  • passive elicitation 默认用未设 seed 的 Python random.choice 选择剩余偏好，而 option shuffling 使用 module-level NumPy seed 42；evaluation script 没有设置 passive seed。即使 agent 与 simulator temperature 为 0，单次运行结果也可能因环境随机性变化。
  • 精确 best_id reward 可能在语义并列的 correct option 中强制单一赢家。已检查的 restaurant record 承认两个选项 cost level 相同，却只指定一个 best ID。当前没有覆盖 3,122 个任务的 best-option 并列、correct/wrong/noise 语义与 rationale 一致性审计。
  • one-choice termination 不等于成功：任何提交的 option 都可能消耗一个 aspect，包括 wrong option；全部 aspect 被消耗后 episode 可能结束。reward 与 termination 必须分开分析。
  • split 证据只确认 2,651 train 与 471 test 之间 exact ID 零重叠；split rule、seed、grouping policy、语义近重复分析、外部 benchmark overlap、model-pretraining contamination 与公开后的 exposure policy 均未披露。
  • 仓库根目录采用 Apache-2.0，但没有单独 dataset card 或权利声明覆盖全部生成 scenario/option、上游 preference source、human supervision 与 model-provider output term。annotator 招募、资质、分工、agreement、adjudication、报酬与 consent 均为 unknown。
  • 环境是带静态预生成 option 的 synthetic/mock travel domain，可能奖励精确 argument matching 与 option-ID 行为，而非稳健的在线搜索或真实用户偏好处理。主结果为单次运行，也没有独立复现。
  • 论文只评测 agent。2,651 行 train split 与未来 SFT/RL 支持讨论不能证明 SFT、RLVR、PRM、reward-model 或 agent-RL 用途。benchmark score 不是训练数据质量证据。
  • artifact 没有 tag 或 GitHub Release。数据在 arXiv v1 之后加入，确切带日期 GPT-4o endpoint 为 unknown，dependency/API behavior 也未被不可变固定。复用必须固定 commit 80506d2 或其他明确 revision，并记录 hash 与 configuration。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned environment_agent_trajectory_data track, UserBench is most useful as a version-pinned evaluation environment and an audit case for how task specifications become runtime episodes. A researcher can map the initial underspecified request to an action schema, simulated-user and search observations, elicited-preference state, option labels, per-step reward, and termination. The key track lesson is that the reusable release stops at task/environment specifications: episodes can be generated, but the paper's actual successful and failed rollouts are not released.

The construction pipeline provides a benchmark recipe. Builders can represent preferences separately from their indirect utterances, compose them across aspects and difficulty tiers, generate correct/wrong/noise option pools, wrap task IDs in environment-launch records, and expose clarification/search/answer actions through a Gym interface. A sound adaptation should additionally publish construction prompts, model versions, seeds, retries, rejected items, human review assignments, split logic, semantic deduplication, per-record lineage, and data-specific rights.

The mixed feedback contract supports verifier research. Investigators can compare GPT-4o search/action classifications with blinded human labels, repeat judgments to estimate variance, swap judge models or prompts, mutate search arguments to measure boundary errors, and test whether option-ID rules reward semantic ties incorrectly. State-transition tests should distinguish successful completion from one-choice termination and should exercise passive elicitation under fixed seeds.

The public task labels and code also support failure and contamination audits. Analysts can search for exact and semantic train/test duplicates, inspect whether public best_id, correct/wrong/noise labels and evaluator prompts enable shortcuts, test early guessing and aspect-state failures, and compare active versus passive preference acquisition. Count reconciliation should treat 417, 471, 4K+, 10K+, 3,122, and 6,244 as different claims with different units rather than selecting the largest number.

Safe reuse is evaluation and audit only, pinned to commit 80506d2 with explicit task files, dependencies, judge/simulator endpoint, prompts, seeds, and environment configuration. Training reuse is blocked pending a data-specific license and lineage review, split/decontamination audit, complete label and verifier calibration, and release of representative successful and failed trajectories with raw feedback. The presence of a train split or a Gym interface does not itself authorize or validate SFT/RL reuse.

对指定的 environment_agent_trajectory_data track，UserBench 最适合作为固定版本的 evaluation environment，以及审计 task specification 如何变成 runtime episode 的案例。研究者可以把初始信息不足的请求映射到 action schema、模拟用户与 search observation、已获取偏好状态、option label、逐步 reward 与 termination。该 track 最重要的结论是：可复用 release 止于 task/environment specification；episode 可以生成，但论文实际的成功与失败 rollout 未发布。

构造 pipeline 提供了一套 benchmark recipe。构建者可以把 preference 与其间接 utterance 分开表示，跨 aspect 和 difficulty tier 组合偏好，生成 correct/wrong/noise option pool，用 environment-launch record 封装 task ID，并通过 Gym interface 暴露 clarification/search/answer action。更可靠的改编还应发布 construction prompt、model version、seed、retry、被拒条目、human review assignment、split 规则、语义去重、逐记录 lineage 与数据专用权利声明。

混合反馈契约可用于 verifier 研究。研究者可以用盲评 human label 对比 GPT-4o 的 search/action classification，通过重复判断估计 variance，替换 judge model 或 prompt，修改 search argument 测量边界错误，并测试 option-ID 规则是否错误惩罚语义并列项。state-transition test 应区分成功完成与 one-choice termination，并在固定 seed 下测试 passive elicitation。

公开 task label 与代码还支持 failure 和 contamination audit。分析者可以搜索 train/test 的精确和语义重复，检查公开 best_id、correct/wrong/noise label 与 evaluator prompt 是否产生 shortcut，测试过早猜测和 aspect-state failure，并比较 active 与 passive preference acquisition。数量调和应把 417、471、4K+、10K+、3,122 与 6,244 视为单位不同的不同主张，而不是选择最大数字。

安全复用等级是仅限 evaluation 与 audit：固定到 commit 80506d2，并明确 task file、dependency、judge/simulator endpoint、prompt、seed 与 environment configuration。训练复用仍被以下事项阻断：数据专用许可证与 lineage 审查、split/去污染审计、完整 label 与 verifier 校准，以及发布带 raw feedback 的代表性成功/失败 trajectory。存在 train split 或 Gym interface 本身不能授权或验证 SFT/RL 复用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Freeze the evidence timeline: arXiv v1 is dated 2025-07-29, benchmark data were added on 2025-08-05, and the inspected official repository state is commit 80506d2; there is no tag or GitHub Release.
  • Count by identity, not rows: 3,122 unique tasks equal 2,651 train plus 471 test. The 6,244 Parquet rows repeat those IDs across single- and multi-choice variants; 417, 4K+, and 10K+ are conflicting or differently scoped paper claims.
  • Read the evaluator as mixed. GPT-4o judges searches and clarification utterances and simulates the user; code parses option IDs, assigns 1.0/0.8/0.0 answer rewards, updates state, and terminates episodes.
  • Audit replay before comparing scores: Figure 8 and repository judge-type numbering differ, passive elicitation is unseeded by default, and at least one official record forces one best_id despite an acknowledged cost tie.
  • Keep the use boundary strict: the paper reports evaluation only, Parquet files are task launch records, and no complete successful/failed trajectory archive was verified. A train split and future SFT/RL discussion are not training evidence.

• 首先固定证据时间线：arXiv v1 日期为 2025 年 7 月 29 日，benchmark 数据于 2025 年 8 月 5 日加入，已检查的官方仓库状态是 commit 80506d2；不存在 tag 或 GitHub Release。
  • 应按 identity 而非行数计数：3,122 个唯一 task 等于 2,651 train 加 471 test；6,244 个 Parquet 行是在 single-choice 与 multi-choice variant 之间重复这些 ID，417、4K+ 与 10K+ 则是冲突或范围不同的论文主张。
  • evaluator 必须按 mixed 理解：GPT-4o 判断 search 与 clarification utterance 并模拟用户；代码解析 option ID、分配 1.0/0.8/0.0 answer reward、更新 state 并终止 episode。
  • 比较 score 前应先审计 replay：Figure 8 与仓库的 judge-type 编号不同，passive elicitation 默认未设 seed，且至少一条官方记录在承认 cost 并列时仍强制指定一个 best_id。
  • 用途边界必须严格：论文只报告 evaluation，Parquet 文件是 task launch record，也没有核验到完整成功/失败 trajectory archive。train split 与未来 SFT/RL 讨论不是训练证据。

value.html: Versioned travel-planning task and executable environment specifications that generate multi-turn preference-elicitation, search, and recommendation episodes at runtime; the release does not contain a complete corpus of paper-run trajectories.

items: correct, wrong, and noise options with IDs and reasons
one designated best option ID and rationale

value.html: Authors curate travel preferences and indirect expressions across flight, hotel, apartment, rental-car, and restaurant aspects; random preference combinations form difficulty-tiered scenarios, and GPT-4o generates ideal arrangement text. Exact upstream sources and per-item curator provenance are undisclosed.

The agent sees the initial underspecified request, simulated-user replies, search success/errors, and a shuffled set of pre-generated options after a valid search; labels, preference inventory, and option reasons remain hidden from the tested model.
One required interact_with_env function call per turn containing thought, choice in {action, answer, search}, and content.
Every turn must call interact_with_env with thought, one of search/action/answer, and textual content. Answers submit one option ID at a time; the main setting permits one choice per travel aspect.

No fixed released trace author. During evaluation, each tested model produces thought plus action/search/answer tool calls while GPT-4o judges requests and simulates the user. Complete evaluated episodes are not released.

A Gymnasium TravelGym environment backed by eight static JSON scenario databases, OpenAI-compatible GPT-4o judge/user calls, pre-generated mock search results, configurable search failures, passive preference elicitation, and one-/multi-choice evaluation modes.

GPT-4o judges whether searches match all ground-truth arguments and whether clarification utterances target an available preference. Rule-based code parses answer IDs and looks them up in correct/best sets. Default rewards are 0.2 for a newly valid search, 0.2 for a newly elicited preference, 1.0 for the designated best option, 0.8 for another correct option, and 0.0 for a wrong option.

Natural-language feedback, newly elicited preference IDs, step reward, elicitation counters, remaining correct/best option state, and episode termination/truncation state. Raw GPT-4o judge responses and paper-run replay logs are not released as a dataset.

Mixed per-transition scalar feedback with terminal answer quality. Paper scores normalize best/correct/wrong option rewards per aspect; complete episode return semantics for training are not demonstrated in this paper.

The environment terminates when all best-option IDs are removed or, in one-choice mode, when one option has been submitted for every aspect; it truncates at the configured maximum steps. Termination can occur after wrong aspect choices and therefore is not itself a success predicate.

At commit 80506d2, eight environment JSON files plus 32 small Parquet files. Each choice variant contains the same 3,122 unique task IDs: 2,651 train and 471 test; total serialized Parquet rows are 6,244 because single- and multi-choice variants duplicate task identities.

Curated preference inventory and implicit utterances -> random cross-aspect combination -> GPT-4o ideal scenario and option generation under human supervision -> structured JSON task/options/labels -> train/test and single-/multi-choice Parquet wrappers -> runtime model/GPT-4o/environment episode -> mixed judge/rule rewards.
Not a training recipe. The paper evaluates GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Pro, Claude-4-Sonnet, Deepseek-V3, Qwen3-14B/32B/8B, Llama-3.3-70B, GPT-4o-mini, Llama-3.1-8B, and Gemini-2.5-Flash.
unknown

GPT-4o generates ideal travel-arrangement statements and option databases under human supervision. At evaluation time GPT-4o also judges searches and clarification utterances and generates simulated-user replies.
Five author-selected travel aspects, 82 final preference categories/items reported in Table 2, and 902 implicit elicitation ways; exact external source lineage is unknown.

Randomly combine preferences across aspects into Travel-22, 2222, 33, 233, 333, 44, 334, and 444 compositions, then split into 2,651 train and 471 test IDs. Main evaluation uses one rollout/sample per model-task at temperature 0.
One run per model-task for main reported results; pass-k is studied only as an analysis ablation, with the exact sampled trajectory release unavailable.
0.0 for evaluated agents and the GPT-4o simulator/judge. Scenario/option construction temperature is unknown.

Gymnasium reset/step interface; required function calling; three action types; pre-generated mock option databases; every fifth search simulates failure; passive elicitation after three off-topic turns; single- and multi-choice modes.
unknown

Implicit expressions are curated/validated to be indirect but unambiguous; GPT-4o options are human supervised; wrong options violate at least one preference and noise options are irrelevant or unrealistic. Exact rejection counts, reviewer protocol, and automated checks are unknown.
GPT-4o at temperature 0.0 with a 15-second timeout, prompt-based search/action judging, implicit preference response generation, and fallback responses. Exact dated model endpoint is unknown.
Maximum 20 interaction turns and 2,048 output tokens per turn; paper reports 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs for the whole evaluation, mainly to host open-source models.

Author-curated preference concepts and indirect phrasings, GPT-4o-generated scenario/option content, human-supervised option review, static mock travel databases, and runtime outputs from tested models plus a GPT-4o judge/user simulator. Per-record human/model attribution is not released.

Verified release: 2,651 train and 471 test unique IDs with no ID overlap, duplicated across single- and multi-choice Parquet variants. Paper §3.5 says 417 test, but Table 2 and the official release both support 471. Split seed, grouping policy, and semantic-near-duplicate audit are undisclosed.

The paper compares benchmark traits with prior environments but discloses no systematic prompt, preference, option, code, or model-pretraining overlap search. Public tasks, labels, prompts, and evaluator code create future contamination and benchmark-specific optimization risk.
unknown

No complete successful/failed rollout archive was found. The release retains correct, wrong, and noise task options and the paper shows two positive and one negative case study, but full model episodes, judge outputs, retries, fallbacks, and dropped-run accounting are unavailable.

label: Verifier / judge failure modes
验证器与评审失效模式

items: GPT-4o classifications control search validity, clarification validity, preference IDs, simulated-user text, and two 0.2 rewards; no judge calibration, variance, or adversarial audit is reported.
The paper's judge-type numbering does not match the repository prompt/code mapping, so implementations copied from the appendix can invert behavior.

Default passive preference selection uses unseeded Python random.choice, while the paper attributes one-run reproducibility to temperature 0; API calls at temperature 0 are also not guaranteed bitwise deterministic.

A representative released best_id_thought explicitly says two restaurant options have the same cost level and either could be chosen, yet only one receives best reward 1.0; semantic label ties can create false penalties.
One-choice termination counts an aspect after any submitted option, including a wrong one; environment termination is not equivalent to successful completion.
Public scenario IDs, correct/best option labels, option reasons, judge prompts, and evaluator code permit direct gaming and future contamination.
Static synthetic search results improve stability but may reward benchmark-specific argument matching and option-ID strategies rather than robust real-world preference handling.

value.html: Travel scenarios/options are described as curated and synthetic/mock. The paper mentions human supervision but does not disclose curator recruitment, consent, compensation, agreement, or whether any implicit phrasings derive from real user text.

Repository root is Apache-2.0 and the paper uses arXiv's non-exclusive distribution license.
